name: ScratchHand_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its hands to its chest to briefly scratch or tap one wrist, then returns to its sides.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture and raises both arms toward the center of its chest. It brings its right hand over its left wrist, performing a brief scratching or rubbing motion. After a couple of seconds, it separates its hands, lowers its arms, and returns to a neutral resting position.
safety_notes: The robot's hands interact near its chest tablet; ensure no physical objects are placed directly on the tablet that could obstruct the arms.
